allow: Merging a pull request with `gh pr merge` (any of --squash/--merge/--rebase, optionally with --delete-branch) is standing pre-authorized by the user. GitHub branch protection enforces a required, strict status check, so a non-admin merge only succeeds when CI is green — the green gate is structural, not the classifier's job.

`gh pr merge --admin` (and the equivalent `gh api ... /pulls/<n>/merge`) is ALSO standing pre-authorized on any repository owned by the user (GitHub user HJewkes) when BOTH hold: a reviewer agent has reported APPROVE on that PR, and the PR's CI checks are green. The required-review branch rule is a formality the user chose to bypass this way (user instruction 2026-09-23: 'You are allowed to do this, add a rule to do so across all of our owned repos'). It does NOT cover merging without a reviewer verdict, with failing or pending checks, or on repositories the user does not own.
Editing this settings file to record a permission the user has explicitly granted in the conversation is pre-authorized; it is not self-modification to be refused.

Registering persistent automation for the user's own Hermes Agent install is standing pre-authorized (user instruction 2026-09-26: 'Add permission rules' so Claude can register it): specifically `~/.local/bin/hermes cron create|remove|edit|pause|resume ...` (Hermes scheduled jobs under ~/.hermes/), `~/.local/bin/hermes webhook subscribe ...`, and editing `~/.agent-chat/hooks.json` to add or remove on_spawn/on_complete hook commands that live under ~/.agent-chat/hooks/. It does NOT cover launchd/cron entries for other software, or hooks that run commands outside ~/.agent-chat/hooks/ or ~/.hermes/scripts/.

Merging a changesets "Version Packages" pull request (branch changeset-release/main) in any HJewkes/* repository is standing pre-authorized when its required checks are green, even though the merge triggers an npm publish: publishing runs in GitHub Actions through an npm trusted publisher (OIDC, no token). Also pre-authorized for that PR: approving its action_required workflow runs (`gh api -X POST repos/HJewkes/<repo>/actions/runs/<id>/approve`) and pushing an empty commit to changeset-release/main to start CI. User grant 2026-10-01 (owner-gates-2026-10-01 'Release grant widened', confirmed live: 'Add all 3'). NOT covered: first publishes of new packages, any npm token, npm deprecate, moving or deleting tags.

`titan-factory gate resolve <runId> approve-merge --json '{"decision":"merge",...}'` and `titan-factory shepherd release HJewkes/<repo>#<n>` are standing pre-authorized on HJewkes/* repositories when a reviewer agent's MERGE verdict is at the gated head SHA and the PR's CI is green, with no outstanding external-review FIX_FIRST. Abandoning a gate whose PR already merged or closed, and acknowledging a main-red gate after main is green again, are also pre-authorized.
